items.overview: New Year’s Eve 2025. Jajo (17) steals her grandmother’s ashes to wander the scorching streets of Santiago, attempting to cope with grief through a series of absurd situations.
items.title: Back Before Midnight

items.original_title: Linda y Bobby en un pozo
items.overview: In the mountains of a small village in Murcia, Francisca, a mother who never knew her own, decides to go with her husband and son to look for the mother she never knew in some wells that, according to local legend, are inhabited by forgotten souls.
items.title: Linda y Bobby en un pozo

items.overview: After a profound loss, Miggy struggles to accept a life without his wife. He continues their usual routines and holds on to the memories they shared, as if nothing has changed. However, when a curious young girl named Tala enters his life, her simple questions make him begin to doubt what he believes to be true. As the story unfold, Miggy slowly questions his memories and the world around him. He soon faces a truth he has spent so long trying to escape, learning that sometimes, letting go of the past is the first step toward finding peace.
items.title: Anatomy of Absence

items.overview: A young boy struggles to put his knowledge to good use. As he faces the choices before him, he must decide whether to use his abilities wisely or let his potential go to waste.
items.title: Acedia

items.overview: Vishnu has twenty minutes to get to his local post office, if he doesn't he loses his job. Surely he can make it no?
items.title: Evidently Chickentown

items.overview: Under the ruthless rule of the mighty and evil EL OSO, four subjects secretly plot their revenge, scheming to overthrow the existing regime and seize power for themselves...
items.title: EL OSO

items.overview: The story of Monte Melkonian , National Hero of Armenia, Hero of Artsakh and one of the commanders of the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. Based entirely on real events confirmed by Monte’s widow, Seta Melkonian.
items.title: Monte

items.overview: New Year’s Eve 2025. Jajo (17) steals her grandmother’s ashes to wander the scorching streets of Santiago, attempting to cope with grief through a series of absurd situations.
items.title: Back Before Midnight

items.original_title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon
items.title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon

items.overview: In a vast darkness, a girl tries to find her way using the only light she can find, one coveted by others.
items.title: Starlight

items.overview: When tragedy threatens to tear a family apart, love, sacrifice, and painful choices test the unbreakable bond between a mother and her children.
items.title: Keevve?

items.overview: One evening, in a classroom, two friends are quietly working. Néo shows Lucas his Halloween mask. Later, while trying to scare his friend with his own mask, Lucas finds himself confronted with a strange transformation.
items.title: The ghost mask

items.overview: As dementia gradually erodes her memory, 60-year-old celebrated theater actor Maya struggles to separate reality from the roles she has performed on stage.
items.title: A Lone Jamun Tree

items.overview: Two mates chat over coffee
items.title: Pair of Pickles

items.overview: The three crew members of the Gorgonia squadron, aided by advanced AI technology, set out on a routine space mission aboard their ships, "Cetus" and "Forcis"—unaware that this journey will change their lives forever. Gorgonia is more than just a space mission; it is a voyage into the deepest fears of its crew.
items.title: Gorgonia

items.overview: A drama with significant social impact that seeks to bring to light the invisible scars left by violence, and which is part of a nationwide awareness campaign.
items.title: Huellas

items.overview: Jinju, an airport guide facing the loss of her job to a machine, receives unexpected news of a pregnancy and discovers suspicious footage of her husband on a dashcam, then follows the trail it leaves.
items.title: Being Human

items.overview: Sowan can stop time. The catch? Once time stands still, she's the only thing that moves. Not a single person, not even a leaf. Its only use? Gazing at her crush, unnoticed. Sowan, who freezes up in front of the goal, starts one-on-one lessons with her futsal coach, Wooseok.
items.title: DIDIMBAL

items.overview: Young-woo, a motorcycle courier, spends his days racing through the streets of Seoul. Eun-young works as a toll booth attendant at a tollgate cutting through the heart of the city. Longtime lovers, they plan to finish work on December 31 and meet at Namsan to watch the New Year’s celebration together.
items.title: NOWHERE

items.overview: All I inherited from Algeria was a song. A melody my grandfather hummed every day, which turned out to be a trace of the internment of Algerian Jews in the Bedeau camp in Algeria between 1941 and 1943. Blending intimate narrative and historical inquiry, the film follows the thread of this truncated memory and transforms oblivion into a collective story.
items.title: Bedeau, Transit Camp

items.overview: To make a name for herself as the only female performer in the Marrakesh area, Hanane, a young woman from a modest Moroccan village, has raised her own troupe of female riders. The challenges are considerable since fantasia, a festive celebration of equestrian warfare, is a costly and traditionally male-exclusive activity. In the face of social injustices, clashes with her father, cultural pressures, Hanane fights day after day to make her dream come to life. With bulldozers threatening to tear down her village to build luxury suburbs, she knows she has no time to lose. If she wants to save her family and her horses, she needs to gain recognition. She sets upon taking her troupe to the most prestigious moussem in Morocco, where the best riders in the kingdom compete every year.
items.title: Banou

items.overview: A sharp detective investigates a grisly diner massacre, but her mind is consumed by a stolen roasted chicken recipe. Contaminating evidence, she draws bizarre parallels between the victims and her culinary obsession in this surreal noir.
items.title: The Cranberry Effect

items.original_title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story
items.overview: A former YouTube child creator revisits her time on the wildly popular Seven Awesome Kids network to reveal the rise and fall of the online community that brought its members fame - and its owner infamy.
items.title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story

items.overview: Liv just wants to break out of her daily routine for once and go on vacation with her husband Anton and son Basti. But even just before Christmas, Anton can’t make her wish come true. That’s because working at his father Franz’s mountain cabin keeps the whole family tied up around the clocks, 24/7—with no end in sight. And because Anton can’t even manage a small gesture like an Advent calendar, Liv takes a stand and moves in with her friend Sigi. It’s a message Anton understands: with a homemade Advent calendar, he tries to win Liv back—and hides something very special behind the first door.
items.title: 24 Türchen zu dir

items.overview: KIM Young-Chul runs a small liquor store on the outskirts of an American city. Before he dies, he dreams of returning to his hometown in Korea, but the money he has saved over a lifetime is not enough to buy a home in Seoul. Worse, he has lost contact with his son, Steve Kim. One day, Kim Chul-Gi, a church butler, approaches him. An undocumented immigrant, Chul-Gi secretly drives an illegal call taxi and takes on shady jobs for wealthy international students. Behind the scenes, he is planning a fraud involving stolen identities of Korean Americans and foreign students. Meanwhile, Kim Sun-Ho, who came to the United States to obtain a degree and permanent residency, crosses paths with Steve Kim, Young-Chul’s estranged son. Four men become entangled like a Möbius strip, each chasing a different version of the same promise. What does the “American Dream” truly mean for those who live outside it?
items.title: 4Kims

items.overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.
items.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming

items.overview: Quand Janet dort portrays Janet Lumb, a Chinese-Canadian artist who has lived in Montreal for many years. Fuelled by dreams and chaos, her artistic world takes shape through performance and musical composition. At 72, Janet is losing her memory. Her artistic and political legacy, along with the details of her life, are fading, though they remain deeply precious to her friend Laurence. To shake up her daily routine, create new memories and revive old ones, he spontaneously plans a trip to Ecuador. Through a polyphonic narrative moving between spoken and written voices, a memory that spans generations gradually emerges. Together, these voices invite reflection on belonging and what is passed down. Janet’s embodied presence, the archival materials documenting her impact and the tenderness with which she is portrayed celebrate the quiet strength of her work and activism.
items.title: Quand Janet dort

items.overview: Alexei, an elite war android modeled after the youthful image of an aging dictator, serves as commanding officer in a refugee district, leading the suppression of a rebellion. There, he encounters Michael, the last remaining Catholic priest, and awakens to faith—beginning a dangerous journey in search of redemption.
items.title: Raphael

items.overview: A film that centers on a young, lower-middle-class man named Anush. Living in tight, limited housing, Anush plans to keep things simple and spend his honeymoon right at home with his new wife. However, his plans completely unravel on his wedding day when his mother is unexpectedly forced to move into their tiny, single-bedroom apartment.
items.title: Honeymoon Tomorrow

items.overview: When Christmas-averse business executive Jen is reluctantly tasked with looking after her sister’s two kids, handsome neighbor Adam helps her navigate holiday disasters, rediscover family, and open her heart to an unexpected romance this holiday season.
items.title: An Unexpected Christmas Plan

items.overview: A double feature of The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo’s Child
items.title: The Gruffalo: From Father to Son

items.overview: The epic conclusion to the Shane saga arrives. When Marcus Wiley gains the powers of the Red Room and escapes from prison, it's up to Shane to stop his father- once and for all.
items.title: Shane V

items.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.
items.title: Snow in June

items.overview: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.
items.title: Delhi 2021

items.overview: On the brink of turning 18 and terrified of adult responsibilities, a teenager finds a pair of glasses that transports him back to the "safe haven" of 2016. But when the portal begins to collapse, a frantic race against time begins, leaving him with only two choices: remain trapped in his memories forever, or take on the biggest responsibility of all—growing up to save his life.
items.title: ODISEA 2016

items.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
items.title: Lilo & Scratch

items.overview: Storage rooms advertised as apartments, unexplained skin rashes, endless spreadsheets and dates that go horrifically wrong.  María is surviving, barely, the ordeal of flat-hunting in a big city while clocking in every day at a job that bores her to death. Her life is a parade of small disasters. But somewhere between the absurdity, María is discovering who she really is. And across the city, so is everyone else; the hard way.
items.title: CHICA BUSCA PISO

items.overview: This is the story of a filmmaker. Alain Cavalier, always accompanied by his camera, continues to film life with passion, still learning about himself and, above all, about others. However, he is growing older and sees his speed, his vitality, his boldness, and his lightheartedness waning. With a slight lump in his throat but still laughing, he keeps a video diary of his farewell to cinema. This will be his last film.
items.title: Thanks for Coming

items.overview: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.
items.title: Congo Boy

items.overview: In the dormant rooms of a family home, a man reads his father's journal then summons his spirit
items.title: House of Glory

items.overview: Do-ah initiates a lawsuit against her husband's uncle who takes away a piece of land that her husband's grandfather left them. Do-ah decides to initiate the lawsuit, unable to stand by when the land and medicine business that her family has worked so hard to realize is stolen before her eyes. But she has no material evidence, and she knows nothing about legal procedures or what to do in court, leading to an extremely difficult situation for her. However in the midst of these troubles, she is reminded of the mysterious and rare treasure that can be used to solve any situation and to locate the expansive at land inside of her which she used to know.
items.title: A Vast Algorithm of Humanity: The Movie

items.overview: An 18-year-old North Korean defector, Lee Sun-hwa, crosses the Duman River, traversing the thin boundary between life and death, and arrives in South Korea. Upon completing her resettlement program at Hanawon, she is placed in a public housing unit in Nowon, Seoul. Yet, life in the South feels like an uncharted world. Choosing to enroll in a South Korean high school rather than extend her stay at Hanawon, she soon finds herself struggling—both academically and culturally. Her only wish is to reunite with her family.
items.title: A Poet of the River

items.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.
items.title: The Boom Killer

items.overview: Against the coastal backdrop of Oslob, Cebu, a young woman drifts from place to place, carrying an unresolved anger from the loss of her father at a young age, until her path crosses with a lonely ex-criminal, also haunted by shadows from the past.
items.title: Laya

items.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
items.title: Hexed

items.overview: Gyu-bin, a college student without a home, is struggling to meet her basic needs. One day, she's offered a place to stay by Geum-rim, an elderly woman living in a luxurious house. Geum-rim warmly welcomes her and treats her like a granddaughter. But soon, Gyu-bin senses something is off. She suffers from nightmares and feels a strange presence in the house. She has no choice but to stay, but can she survive what's coming?
items.title: My Home

items.overview: Park Do-soon, the founder of Suneung(South Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test), had failed in his own university entrance exam. His creation—Suneung—would face similar trials. Although designed to put an end to test-oriented education, his new admissions system would be reshaped by external pressures and societal backlash against his intention. Amid the growing controversy, Suneung and the broader admissions reform faced the threat of being scrapped altogether. Ultimately, compromises were made, such as including science and social studies in the test.
items.title: Frankenstein of Korean Education; Founder of Suneung

items.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.
items.title: Forty Love

items.overview: After a suicide attack carried out by a known teenager, Maitê’s investigation leads her to the heart of human darkness, where the greatest of terrors awaits her.
items.title: Labirintite

items.overview: In a dystopian future, sex is outlawed in Brazil. Faced with this abrupt decision, Jorge has until midnight to experience his final act of freedom. In his search, he eventually crosses paths with Ananke.
items.title: Ananke

items.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.
items.title: Hershey

items.overview: A flight from Incheon to London's Kingsford Smith Airport is canceled due to an engine malfunction, and passengers are provided with a complimentary overnight stay at a layover hotel. Six strangers, unexpectedly stranded together, each have a unique and unforeseen experience throughout the night. This temporary stay becomes a moment of reflection on their lives.
items.title: Layover Hotel

items.overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.
items.title: A Good Little Soldier

items.overview: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.
items.title: Double Freedom

items.overview: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.
items.title: Fantasy

items.overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.
items.title: Tristes Tropiques

items.overview: On the eve of retirement, Émile delivers one final lesson about love and literature, urging his students to become the poets of their own lives. But is he still in love himself? Unable to answer, he returns home only to discover that his wife has left him. Émile must now live by the very words he’s been preaching, and thanks to unexpected encounters his life is turned upside down, helping him to reinvent himself.
items.title: Love Lessons

items.overview: A European couple's vacation abruptly ends when they're kidnapped in Mexico. A working-class Mexican family is compelled to imprison them, leading to an unexpected cultural clash.
items.title: A Few Days in the Sun

items.original_title: ស្រមោលអតីតកាល
items.overview: Khmer movie
items.title: Echoes

items.overview: Three women fight against time, educating people that have stayed silent as victims of their gender.
items.title: La Novia del Atlántico

items.overview: Cecília, from São Paulo, travels to Recife for an initial reunion with Joaquim, where songs by Martins give substance to their feelings and prolong their farewell. The return flight is already scheduled, but the conversation between the two is still only halfway through.
items.title: Interesting and Obscene

items.overview: The rain intensifies in the favela furthest from the center of Curitiba, along with Davi's fever. His parents, Tereza and Joílson, must cross distances, overcome scarcity, and endure pain to achieve their most basic rights.
items.title: Caximba's Rain

items.overview: A local serial killer gets more than he bargained for when he falls in love for the first time.
items.title: That Handsome Devil!

items.overview: The Desire
items.title: Desire

items.overview: A trans woman, forcibly detained in a dark room, undergoes an inner journey of reconciliation, coming to understand the inevitability of her own existence.
items.title: nothing else matters

items.overview: A spiraling group of friends turn on each other when a friendly game of ‘Mafia’ comes to life. If you die in the game, you die in real life… which friend is the killer? Or are they all to blame?
items.title: A Friendly Massacre

items.overview: After more than twenty years in prison for his political militancy in 1980s Italy, Roby Olivero receives news of his release. During his final hours behind bars, he says goodbye to his fellow inmates and faces the challenge of reclaiming a freedom that may not necessarily free him from his past.
items.title: Liberante

items.overview: Lu, a young hypochondriac, wears a cast that no longer serves his body. Isolated in a suffocating routine, he waits for something to break the endless repetition of his days. An unexpected impulse forces him to confront what he fears most: the risk of breaking again.
items.title: Waiting Room

items.overview: Ali tries to create the perfect job application but keeps running into obstacles.
items.title: Ali, I mean Matias

items.overview: A young woman starts following a mysterious elderly woman. The journey turns into a dreamlike passage  through life towards the unknown.
items.title: Ohikiitävää

items.overview: A group of friends stop for a late night snack, but a fateful kebab roll changes everything. Based on true events.
items.title: Suuri rullakebab välikohtaus

items.overview: Belial, a man in the middle of a mental breakdown, confronts himself in a bathroom mirror.
items.title: Belial

items.overview: Julia Pérez, an ambitious haute couture designer and leader of a satanic cult, will stop at nothing in her pursuit of prestige and power. However, when one of her rituals goes awry, a dark presence takes hold of her mansion, unleashing a wave of brutal deaths. Trapped between her desperate thirst for power and the supernatural horror she herself unleashed, Julia will discover that the price of eternal fame is the most painful of hells.
items.title: Bruleferum

items.overview: Struggling with insomnia, Luka begins experiencing strange events after a walk through the forest. As mysterious photographs and a shadowy figure appear to follow him, he struggles to distinguish reality from his own hallucinations. But the truth may be closer than he thinks.
items.title: Insomnia

items.overview: Some never ask her name. Some ask without truly caring. Some stay by her side without knowing her name. As she connects with them and drifts apart, a woman makes her way through one summer night.
items.title: In Conversation with Beings

items.overview: The film is told through the eyes of a granddaughter who recorded the memories of her grandfather, who was forcibly mobilized to Palau during the Pacific War. Through the military facilities left behind by the Japanese forces during the colonial period and the sites that still bear traces of Yeosu–Suncheon 10·19 (1948), the film follows the remnants of two tragedies that intersected in one man’s life and continue to linger in the present.
items.title: The Place Returned To

items.overview: Minchan and Sohee visit several homes in search of a place to live together. They move through a house that seems quiet but is filled with the noise of passing trains, a home marked by the traces of an elderly woman living alone, and an apartment full of the everyday clutter of a family with a child. Eventually, they arrive at an apartment said to overlook a royal tomb. The “royal-tomb view,” described as something of special value, can only be seen by stepping up onto a stool.
items.title: The View

items.overview: Jaemin and Junghyun decide to rest at home for 30 minutes before leaving for their trip.
items.title: Travel

items.overview: Marcelo “Tetón” Sánchez is a professional boxer who lives in Hurlingham, in the western suburbs of Buenos Aires. For one year, the camera follows his training sessions, his family life, and his work at the gym, where he helps local youths stay off the streets and away from drugs. While supporting his family with his earnings from the ring, he prepares for a decisive fight that could open doors for him to compete abroad and improve his financial future.
items.title: Oeste

items.overview: In a desperate attempt to find solace, a young man joins a local support group where he meets a stranger whose outward charm masks far darker intentions.
items.title: Because You're Mine

items.overview: A film inspired by myth and the enduring relationship between people and nature on the outskirts of Hanoi. The camera glides above dark waters, following swimmers, fishermen, fires, and rituals that persist within an expanding urban landscape. Karaoke, street vendors, insects, machinery, old songs, and distant gongs merge into a flowing soundscape.  Undercurrents transforms everyday encounters into a sensory, fairy-tale-like narrative, revealing the river and surrounding landscape as active forces shaping human lives.
items.title: Undercurrents

items.original_title: Today Belongs to a Few and Tomorrow to No One
items.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, the last two people left on Earth travel through cities, collecting remnants of a vanished past. The film is accompanied by W. S. Merwin’s poem “Whenever I Go There.”
items.title: Today Belongs to a Few and Tomorrow to No One

items.overview: Moving between personal experience and collective memory, the film becomes an intimate inquiry into inherrited a history of nomad’s life and displacement. Rather than reconstructing the past, it listens to what remains: in the land, in the silences, and in the stories carried across generations.
items.title: The Road Comes Into View

items.overview: “Preila Project” is set in a quiet Lithuanian seaside resort, where threads of memory, history, and imagination intersect. One of them is contemporary images of the resort, which are fragmented narratives of rest, boredom, and escape to the periphery. The other thread is historical, going back to 1998, when a treasure hunt unfolded in Preila. At the time, it was speculated that it could be the Amber Room, which was lost during the Second World War and hailed as the eighth wonder of the world. The third thread draws on overheard stories, newspaper clippings, and radio announcements, thus blurring the line between fiction and documentary. Combining video, sound, and found materials, “Preila Project” becomes an atmospheric exploration of place, where fantasy and reality, past and present, melt together.
items.title: Preila Project

With bulldozers threatening to tear down her village to build luxury suburbs, she knows she has no time to lose. If she wants to save her family and her horses, she needs to gain recognition. She sets upon taking her troupe to the most prestigious moussem in Morocco, where the best riders in the kingdom compete every year.
results.title: Banou

results.overview: A sharp detective investigates a grisly diner massacre, but her mind is consumed by a stolen roasted chicken recipe. Contaminating evidence, she draws bizarre parallels between the victims and her culinary obsession in this surreal noir.
results.title: The Cranberry Effect

results.original_title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story
results.overview: A former YouTube child creator revisits her time on the wildly popular Seven Awesome Kids network to reveal the rise and fall of the online community that brought its members fame - and its owner infamy.
results.title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story

results.overview: Liv just wants to break out of her daily routine for once and go on vacation with her husband Anton and son Basti. But even just before Christmas, Anton can’t make her wish come true. That’s because working at his father Franz’s mountain cabin keeps the whole family tied up around the clocks, 24/7—with no end in sight. And because Anton can’t even manage a small gesture like an Advent calendar, Liv takes a stand and moves in with her friend Sigi. It’s a message Anton understands: with a homemade Advent calendar, he tries to win Liv back—and hides something very special behind the first door.
results.title: 24 Türchen zu dir

results.overview: KIM Young-Chul runs a small liquor store on the outskirts of an American city. Before he dies, he dreams of returning to his hometown in Korea, but the money he has saved over a lifetime is not enough to buy a home in Seoul. Worse, he has lost contact with his son, Steve Kim. One day, Kim Chul-Gi, a church butler, approaches him. An undocumented immigrant, Chul-Gi secretly drives an illegal call taxi and takes on shady jobs for wealthy international students. Behind the scenes, he is planning a fraud involving stolen identities of Korean Americans and foreign students. Meanwhile, Kim Sun-Ho, who came to the United States to obtain a degree and permanent residency, crosses paths with Steve Kim, Young-Chul’s estranged son. Four men become entangled like a Möbius strip, each chasing a different version of the same promise. What does the “American Dream” truly mean for those who live outside it?
results.title: 4Kims

results.overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.
results.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming

results.overview: Quand Janet dort portrays Janet Lumb, a Chinese-Canadian artist who has lived in Montreal for many years. Fuelled by dreams and chaos, her artistic world takes shape through performance and musical composition. At 72, Janet is losing her memory. Her artistic and political legacy, along with the details of her life, are fading, though they remain deeply precious to her friend Laurence. To shake up her daily routine, create new memories and revive old ones, he spontaneously plans a trip to Ecuador. Through a polyphonic narrative moving between spoken and written voices, a memory that spans generations gradually emerges. Together, these voices invite reflection on belonging and what is passed down. Janet’s embodied presence, the archival materials documenting her impact and the tenderness with which she is portrayed celebrate the quiet strength of her work and activism.
results.title: Quand Janet dort

results.overview: Alexei, an elite war android modeled after the youthful image of an aging dictator, serves as commanding officer in a refugee district, leading the suppression of a rebellion. There, he encounters Michael, the last remaining Catholic priest, and awakens to faith—beginning a dangerous journey in search of redemption.
results.title: Raphael

results.overview: A film that centers on a young, lower-middle-class man named Anush. Living in tight, limited housing, Anush plans to keep things simple and spend his honeymoon right at home with his new wife. However, his plans completely unravel on his wedding day when his mother is unexpectedly forced to move into their tiny, single-bedroom apartment.
results.title: Honeymoon Tomorrow

results.overview: When Christmas-averse business executive Jen is reluctantly tasked with looking after her sister’s two kids, handsome neighbor Adam helps her navigate holiday disasters, rediscover family, and open her heart to an unexpected romance this holiday season.
results.title: An Unexpected Christmas Plan

results.overview: A double feature of The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo’s Child
results.title: The Gruffalo: From Father to Son

results.overview: The epic conclusion to the Shane saga arrives. When Marcus Wiley gains the powers of the Red Room and escapes from prison, it's up to Shane to stop his father- once and for all.
results.title: Shane V

results.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.
results.title: Snow in June

results.overview: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.
results.title: Delhi 2021

results.overview: On the brink of turning 18 and terrified of adult responsibilities, a teenager finds a pair of glasses that transports him back to the "safe haven" of 2016. But when the portal begins to collapse, a frantic race against time begins, leaving him with only two choices: remain trapped in his memories forever, or take on the biggest responsibility of all—growing up to save his life.
results.title: ODISEA 2016

results.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
results.title: Lilo & Scratch

results.overview: Storage rooms advertised as apartments, unexplained skin rashes, endless spreadsheets and dates that go horrifically wrong.  María is surviving, barely, the ordeal of flat-hunting in a big city while clocking in every day at a job that bores her to death. Her life is a parade of small disasters. But somewhere between the absurdity, María is discovering who she really is. And across the city, so is everyone else; the hard way.
results.title: CHICA BUSCA PISO

results.overview: This is the story of a filmmaker. Alain Cavalier, always accompanied by his camera, continues to film life with passion, still learning about himself and, above all, about others. However, he is growing older and sees his speed, his vitality, his boldness, and his lightheartedness waning. With a slight lump in his throat but still laughing, he keeps a video diary of his farewell to cinema. This will be his last film.
results.title: Thanks for Coming

results.overview: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.
results.title: Congo Boy

results.overview: In the dormant rooms of a family home, a man reads his father's journal then summons his spirit
results.title: House of Glory

results.overview: Do-ah initiates a lawsuit against her husband's uncle who takes away a piece of land that her husband's grandfather left them. Do-ah decides to initiate the lawsuit, unable to stand by when the land and medicine business that her family has worked so hard to realize is stolen before her eyes. But she has no material evidence, and she knows nothing about legal procedures or what to do in court, leading to an extremely difficult situation for her. However in the midst of these troubles, she is reminded of the mysterious and rare treasure that can be used to solve any situation and to locate the expansive at land inside of her which she used to know.
results.title: A Vast Algorithm of Humanity: The Movie

results.overview: An 18-year-old North Korean defector, Lee Sun-hwa, crosses the Duman River, traversing the thin boundary between life and death, and arrives in South Korea. Upon completing her resettlement program at Hanawon, she is placed in a public housing unit in Nowon, Seoul. Yet, life in the South feels like an uncharted world. Choosing to enroll in a South Korean high school rather than extend her stay at Hanawon, she soon finds herself struggling—both academically and culturally. Her only wish is to reunite with her family.
results.title: A Poet of the River

results.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.
results.title: The Boom Killer

results.overview: Against the coastal backdrop of Oslob, Cebu, a young woman drifts from place to place, carrying an unresolved anger from the loss of her father at a young age, until her path crosses with a lonely ex-criminal, also haunted by shadows from the past.
results.title: Laya

results.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
results.title: Hexed

results.overview: Gyu-bin, a college student without a home, is struggling to meet her basic needs. One day, she's offered a place to stay by Geum-rim, an elderly woman living in a luxurious house. Geum-rim warmly welcomes her and treats her like a granddaughter. But soon, Gyu-bin senses something is off. She suffers from nightmares and feels a strange presence in the house. She has no choice but to stay, but can she survive what's coming?
results.title: My Home

results.overview: Park Do-soon, the founder of Suneung(South Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test), had failed in his own university entrance exam. His creation—Suneung—would face similar trials. Although designed to put an end to test-oriented education, his new admissions system would be reshaped by external pressures and societal backlash against his intention. Amid the growing controversy, Suneung and the broader admissions reform faced the threat of being scrapped altogether. Ultimately, compromises were made, such as including science and social studies in the test.
results.title: Frankenstein of Korean Education; Founder of Suneung

results.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.
results.title: Forty Love

results.overview: After a suicide attack carried out by a known teenager, Maitê’s investigation leads her to the heart of human darkness, where the greatest of terrors awaits her.
results.title: Labirintite

results.overview: In a dystopian future, sex is outlawed in Brazil. Faced with this abrupt decision, Jorge has until midnight to experience his final act of freedom. In his search, he eventually crosses paths with Ananke.
results.title: Ananke

results.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.
results.title: Hershey

results.overview: A flight from Incheon to London's Kingsford Smith Airport is canceled due to an engine malfunction, and passengers are provided with a complimentary overnight stay at a layover hotel. Six strangers, unexpectedly stranded together, each have a unique and unforeseen experience throughout the night. This temporary stay becomes a moment of reflection on their lives.
results.title: Layover Hotel

results.overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.
results.title: A Good Little Soldier

results.overview: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.
results.title: Double Freedom

results.overview: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.
results.title: Fantasy

results.overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.
results.title: Tristes Tropiques

results.overview: On the eve of retirement, Émile delivers one final lesson about love and literature, urging his students to become the poets of their own lives. But is he still in love himself? Unable to answer, he returns home only to discover that his wife has left him. Émile must now live by the very words he’s been preaching, and thanks to unexpected encounters his life is turned upside down, helping him to reinvent himself.
results.title: Love Lessons

results.overview: A European couple's vacation abruptly ends when they're kidnapped in Mexico. A working-class Mexican family is compelled to imprison them, leading to an unexpected cultural clash.
results.title: A Few Days in the Sun

results.original_title: ស្រមោលអតីតកាល
results.overview: Khmer movie
results.title: Echoes

results.overview: Three women fight against time, educating people that have stayed silent as victims of their gender.
results.title: La Novia del Atlántico

results.overview: Cecília, from São Paulo, travels to Recife for an initial reunion with Joaquim, where songs by Martins give substance to their feelings and prolong their farewell. The return flight is already scheduled, but the conversation between the two is still only halfway through.
results.title: Interesting and Obscene

results.overview: The rain intensifies in the favela furthest from the center of Curitiba, along with Davi's fever. His parents, Tereza and Joílson, must cross distances, overcome scarcity, and endure pain to achieve their most basic rights.
results.title: Caximba's Rain

results.overview: A local serial killer gets more than he bargained for when he falls in love for the first time.
results.title: That Handsome Devil!

results.overview: The Desire
results.title: Desire

results.overview: A trans woman, forcibly detained in a dark room, undergoes an inner journey of reconciliation, coming to understand the inevitability of her own existence.
results.title: nothing else matters

results.overview: A spiraling group of friends turn on each other when a friendly game of ‘Mafia’ comes to life. If you die in the game, you die in real life… which friend is the killer? Or are they all to blame?
results.title: A Friendly Massacre

results.overview: After more than twenty years in prison for his political militancy in 1980s Italy, Roby Olivero receives news of his release. During his final hours behind bars, he says goodbye to his fellow inmates and faces the challenge of reclaiming a freedom that may not necessarily free him from his past.
results.title: Liberante

results.overview: Lu, a young hypochondriac, wears a cast that no longer serves his body. Isolated in a suffocating routine, he waits for something to break the endless repetition of his days. An unexpected impulse forces him to confront what he fears most: the risk of breaking again.
results.title: Waiting Room

results.overview: Ali tries to create the perfect job application but keeps running into obstacles.
results.title: Ali, I mean Matias

results.overview: A young woman starts following a mysterious elderly woman. The journey turns into a dreamlike passage  through life towards the unknown.
results.title: Ohikiitävää

results.overview: A group of friends stop for a late night snack, but a fateful kebab roll changes everything. Based on true events.
results.title: Suuri rullakebab välikohtaus

results.overview: Belial, a man in the middle of a mental breakdown, confronts himself in a bathroom mirror.
results.title: Belial

results.overview: Julia Pérez, an ambitious haute couture designer and leader of a satanic cult, will stop at nothing in her pursuit of prestige and power. However, when one of her rituals goes awry, a dark presence takes hold of her mansion, unleashing a wave of brutal deaths. Trapped between her desperate thirst for power and the supernatural horror she herself unleashed, Julia will discover that the price of eternal fame is the most painful of hells.
results.title: Bruleferum

results.overview: Struggling with insomnia, Luka begins experiencing strange events after a walk through the forest. As mysterious photographs and a shadowy figure appear to follow him, he struggles to distinguish reality from his own hallucinations. But the truth may be closer than he thinks.
results.title: Insomnia

results.overview: Some never ask her name. Some ask without truly caring. Some stay by her side without knowing her name. As she connects with them and drifts apart, a woman makes her way through one summer night.
results.title: In Conversation with Beings

results.overview: The film is told through the eyes of a granddaughter who recorded the memories of her grandfather, who was forcibly mobilized to Palau during the Pacific War. Through the military facilities left behind by the Japanese forces during the colonial period and the sites that still bear traces of Yeosu–Suncheon 10·19 (1948), the film follows the remnants of two tragedies that intersected in one man’s life and continue to linger in the present.
results.title: The Place Returned To

results.overview: Minchan and Sohee visit several homes in search of a place to live together. They move through a house that seems quiet but is filled with the noise of passing trains, a home marked by the traces of an elderly woman living alone, and an apartment full of the everyday clutter of a family with a child. Eventually, they arrive at an apartment said to overlook a royal tomb. The “royal-tomb view,” described as something of special value, can only be seen by stepping up onto a stool.
results.title: The View

results.overview: Jaemin and Junghyun decide to rest at home for 30 minutes before leaving for their trip.
results.title: Travel

results.overview: Marcelo “Tetón” Sánchez is a professional boxer who lives in Hurlingham, in the western suburbs of Buenos Aires. For one year, the camera follows his training sessions, his family life, and his work at the gym, where he helps local youths stay off the streets and away from drugs. While supporting his family with his earnings from the ring, he prepares for a decisive fight that could open doors for him to compete abroad and improve his financial future.
results.title: Oeste

results.overview: In a desperate attempt to find solace, a young man joins a local support group where he meets a stranger whose outward charm masks far darker intentions.
results.title: Because You're Mine

results.overview: A film inspired by myth and the enduring relationship between people and nature on the outskirts of Hanoi. The camera glides above dark waters, following swimmers, fishermen, fires, and rituals that persist within an expanding urban landscape. Karaoke, street vendors, insects, machinery, old songs, and distant gongs merge into a flowing soundscape.  Undercurrents transforms everyday encounters into a sensory, fairy-tale-like narrative, revealing the river and surrounding landscape as active forces shaping human lives.
results.title: Undercurrents

results.original_title: Today Belongs to a Few and Tomorrow to No One
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, the last two people left on Earth travel through cities, collecting remnants of a vanished past. The film is accompanied by W. S. Merwin’s poem “Whenever I Go There.”
results.title: Today Belongs to a Few and Tomorrow to No One

results.overview: Moving between personal experience and collective memory, the film becomes an intimate inquiry into inherrited a history of nomad’s life and displacement. Rather than reconstructing the past, it listens to what remains: in the land, in the silences, and in the stories carried across generations.
results.title: The Road Comes Into View

results.overview: “Preila Project” is set in a quiet Lithuanian seaside resort, where threads of memory, history, and imagination intersect. One of them is contemporary images of the resort, which are fragmented narratives of rest, boredom, and escape to the periphery. The other thread is historical, going back to 1998, when a treasure hunt unfolded in Preila. At the time, it was speculated that it could be the Amber Room, which was lost during the Second World War and hailed as the eighth wonder of the world. The third thread draws on overheard stories, newspaper clippings, and radio announcements, thus blurring the line between fiction and documentary. Combining video, sound, and found materials, “Preila Project” becomes an atmospheric exploration of place, where fantasy and reality, past and present, melt together.
results.title: Preila Project
